title.zh: 将马拉邦市镇Tinajeros描笼涯的Malabon市镇中学Tinajeros附属校分离，改设为独立国立中学并为此拨款
title.en: An Act Separating the Malabon Municipal High School, Tinajeros Annex Situated in Barangay Tinajeros, From the Malabon Municipal High School Situated in Barangay Hulong-duhat, All in the Municipality of Malabon, Metro Manila, Into a Separate and Independent National High School, and Appropriating Funds Therefor
title.orig: An Act Separating the Malabon Municipal High School, Tinajeros Annex Situated in Barangay Tinajeros, From the Malabon Municipal High School Situated in Barangay Hulong-duhat, All in the Municipality of Malabon, Metro Manila, Into a Separate and Independent National High School, and Appropriating Funds Therefor

source.name: LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation）

completenessNote: 全文，共 3 条；逐字取自 LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation） 官方页面（statutes/repacts/ra1994/ra_7827_1994.html），未改写、未摘译、未节选；原文语言：英语。 条文抬头依源文为 “Section N.” 等形式，本库统一规范为 “Section N.”；首行抬头与条内标题的分段依源文块级边界还原。

text.en: The Malabon Municipal High School, Tinajeros Annex situated in Barangay Tinajeros is hereby separated from the Malabon Municipal High School situated in Barangay Hulong-Duhat, all in the Municipality of Malabon, Metro Manila, and shall operate independently under the supervision of the Department of Education, Culture and Sports, and be known as the Tinajeros National High School.

The amount necessary for the implementation of this Act shall be charged against the current year's appropriations of the Malabon National High School, Tinajeros Annex. Thereafter, such sums as may be necessary for its operation and maintenance shall be included in the annual General Appropriations Act.

This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
Approved, November 18, 1994.
